title: Profile: Studio
summary: DJDL's Studio profile, the destination of Open Studio profile: the values Studio devices get, where locks (Read-only, Hidden) are set, one unsaved change that makes run.concurrency Read-only, the profile's place in the five-step chain, and who it reaches.
compare: Profiles lists Default first, labelled "Applies to everyone", then one profile per tier that has one; a tier without its own profile (Standard) is explained under the list with Give Standard a profile. Licenses never list profiles.
A profile holds settings and secrets only; entitlements live on the tier, and the card foot says so.

Each value row: key and label, the value, In the app (Editable, Read-only, Hidden) as one select with its glyph, and remove. Secrets show Configured or Not set, Never listed, and Replace…, never a value.

A changed row is tinted with the draft marker and a note under it says what changed and its effect from the U-29 read ("Read-only blocks 1 license's own value (3)"), matching config.effective's blocked-override case.

Where it sits shows the five steps with this profile as step 3; Used by gives Studio licenses (38), devices (104) and the overrides its locks block, from the same read as each license's Config tab. Those counts show only here: the header has the chain step and the last save, and the list says which tier.
Header: "1 unsaved change" as a neutral pill, Preview as… (license, tier or person), Discard and Save profile.

Phone: the profile list becomes a switcher, each value row becomes a block (key, then value, In the app and remove on one line), and the rail follows. Tablet and desktop: the rail's two cards sit side by side under the values; wide: beside them.
Spacing and copy pass (2026-10-08): the screen sets no spacing of its own (kit primitives only), and each fact shows once, where it's most useful.

Brand v2 shell (lead B2–B5, 2026-10-09): the work sits on the inset canvas with a 3px rule in the page's context accent (full-bleed below 1024); one orientation line (context chip + crumbs, never 'Platform' on a product page, no eyebrow repeating the path); h1 36/44 on a collection, 32/40 on a record, 24/32 on a phone; the one filled primary is ink; focus, hover, checked and selected take the accent of the service the element references (B17), never a status colour; the selected nav item is the subtle fill with a 3px marker; card heads are bands with no numerals; route tabs are an underline tablist with a 3px indicator; tables with filters are one workbench band; weights 400/500/600.
B17: Used by is license (Studio licenses, their devices, blocked license overrides).

findings.issue: "Where it sits" was a fourth copy of the effective ladder and the primary action sat below two secondaries on phone.
findings.resolution: Deleted the card; "Step 3 of 5" opens the header meta (facts separated by dots); "Studio tier" removed from the list and the table foot; value inputs flex (min 120px); 48px rows; phone has a sticky bar with Discard beside Save profile and Preview as... behind the overflow button.
